stem: Which line from the play best supports the idea that Nelson realizes he made a mistake?

options.label: A
options.text: NELSON: Are you sure you didn’t find it here? (line 27)

options.label: B
options.text: NELSON: Don’t you think that’s strange? (line 33)

options.label: C
options.text: NELSON: Poor Lucia was telling the truth all along. (line 44)

options.label: D
options.text: NELSON: But now I have another plan. (line 48)
